title: test(coverage): Add babel-istanbul for coverage
body:
Linked to  #355 .

This adds `npm run test:coverage` which uses `babel-istanbul`.
The difference between `istanbul` and `babel-istanbul` is that it shows coverage on the code before it is compiled by `babel`.
